name: geo-maps
description: Integrate high-quality base map data into your applications using MapLibre.

options.name: --font-stack
options.description: Name of the FontStack to retrieve.  Example: Amazon Ember Bold,Noto Sans Bold.

options.name: --font-unicode-range
options.description: A Unicode range of characters to download glyphs for. This must be aligned to multiples of 256.  Example: 0-255.pdf

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

options.name: --file-name
options.description: Sprites API: The name of the sprite ﬁle to retrieve, following pattern sprites(@2x)?\.(png|json). Example: sprites.png

options.name: --style
options.description: Style specifies the desired map style for the Sprites APIs

options.name: --color-scheme
options.description: Sets color tone for map such as dark and light for specific map styles. It applies to only vector map styles such as Standard and Monochrome.

options.name: --variant
options.description: Optimizes map styles for specific use case or industry. You can choose allowed variant only with Standard map style.

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

subcommands.name: get-static-map
subcommands.description: Provides high-quality static map images with customizable options. You can modify the map's appearance and overlay additional information.

options.name: --bounding-box
options.description: Takes in two pairs of coordinates, [Lon, Lat], denoting south-westerly and north-easterly edges of the image.

options.name: --bounded-positions
options.description: Takes in two or more pair of coordinates, [Lon, Lat], with each coordinate separated by a comma.

options.name: --center
options.description: Takes in a pair of coordinates, [Lon, Lat], which becomes the center point of the image. This parameter requires that either zoom or radius is set.

options.name: --compact-overlay
options.description: Takes in a string to draw geometries on the image.

options.name: --geo-json-overlay
options.description: Takes in a string to draw geometries on the image. The input is a valid GeoJSON collection object.

options.name: --height
options.description: Specifies the height of the map image

options.name: --key
options.description: Optional: The API key to be used for authorization. Either an API key or valid SigV4 signature must be provided when making a request

options.name: --padding
options.description: Applies additional space (in pixels) around overlay feature to prevent them from being cut or obscured.

options.name: --radius
options.description: Used with center parameter, it specifies the zoom of the image where you can control it on a granular level. Takes in any value >= 1.

options.name: --file-name
options.description: The map scaling parameter to size the image, icons, and labels. It follows the pattern of ^map(@2x)?$. Example: map, map@2x

options.name: --scale-bar-unit
options.description: Displays a scale on the bottom right of the map image with the unit specified in the input.  Example: KilometersMiles, Miles, Kilometers, MilesKilometers

options.name: --style
options.description: Style specifies the desired map style for the Style APIs

options.name: --width
options.description: Specifies the width of the map image

options.name: --zoom
options.description: Specifies the zoom level of the map image.  Cannot be used with Radius

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

options.name: --style
options.description: Style specifies the desired map style

options.name: --color-scheme
options.description: Sets color tone for map such as dark and light for specific map styles. It applies to only vector map styles such as Standard and Monochrome.

options.name: --political-view
options.description: Specifies the political view using ISO 3166-2 or ISO 3166-3 country code format.

options.name: --key
options.description: Optional: The API key to be used for authorization. Either an API key or valid SigV4 signature must be provided when making a request

options.name: outfile

subcommands.name: get-tile
subcommands.description: Returns a tile. Map tiles are used by clients to render a map. they're addressed using a grid arrangement with an X coordinate, Y coordinate, and Z (zoom) level

options.name: --tileset
options.description: Specifies the desired tile set. Valid Values: raster.satellite | vector.basemap

options.name: --z
options.description: The zoom value for the map tile

options.name: --x
options.description: The X axis value for the map tile. Must be between 0 and 19

options.name: --y
options.description: The Y axis value for the map tile

options.name: --key
options.description: Optional: The API key to be used for authorization. Either an API key or valid SigV4 signature must be provided when making a request

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved
